title: Between Periods
openIssues: SPEC.md is about 4,950 words and DESIGN.md about 1,250, well over the 900-1500 and 400 word guidance. The 12-file interface contract plus 14 critic items could not fit in less without leaving seams. Lint only has a minimum length.

Depth proof (T3: three bot planners, 100 seeds, jitter test) is the riskiest build item. It is time-boxed to two tuning rounds. If it still fails, the engineer ships the best numbers and records them. T1 determinism and T2 365-seed attainability never ship failing.

The prior-art line (F5: a 2013 browser doodle and at least one commercial game) is search-only. It is not in the idea's research.facts and has no verified URL, so it is shown unlinked as 'per our own web searches, as of 2026-10-12'. The orchestrator may drop it.

The maker's brand appears only inside the source URL zamboni.com/...pdf (needed for the citation). All visible source labels are paraphrased and brand-free. Drop that source if zero occurrences is wanted; the Model A steering fact still has Wikipedia.

Rink dot positions and the net and crease sizes are common-knowledge proportions plus the critic's search-quoted figures. None of it is verified:true, so the page draws it 'stylized' and prints no dimensions.
PROJECT.json makingOf says self-tests check par on 365 daily rinks. The integrator must delete that sentence, in both the About panel and project.json, if those tests did not run and pass.

Fingerprint tags, keywords and tech were adjusted from the idea: ghost-replay and ghost-run became challenge-link and fixed-timestep, web-animations became webaudio. The packaging novelty re-check should still pass.
